title: Neferine Suppresses Experimental Colitis-Associated Colorectal Cancer by Inhibition of NF-[Formula: see text]B p65 and STAT3.
authors: Zhou, Yishan; Xiang, Shuangli; Zheng, Haoyi; Hou, Ying; Wang, Ying; Li, Chuang-Chuang; Wu, Qin; Shi, Jingshan; Chen, Xiuping
journal: The American journal of Chinese medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究莲子心碱通过抑制NF-κB p65和STAT3信号通路抑制结肠炎相关结直肠癌，分子对接仅作为辅助验证小分子与蛋白的相互作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Colitis is an important risk factor for the development of colorectal cancer (CRC). The inhibitory effect and the underlying mechanism of neferine on colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CA-CRC) were investigated using an azoxymethane (AOM)/dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) triggered mice model. Compared with the CA-CRC model, oral treatment of neferine (2.5 and 5.0 mg/kg) significantly inhibited the DAI scores, decreased the tumor number, and reduced the tumor size. Neferine decreased inflammatory cell infiltration and epithelial hyperplasia in colon tissues. The levels of tumor necrosis factor-[Formula: see text] (TNF-[Formula: see text], interleukin-1beta (IL-1[Formula: see text], and interleukin 6 (IL-6) in colon tissues were decreased by neferine. Furthermore, neferine significantly decreased protein expressions of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), p-p65, and p-STAT3 in both tumor and non-tumor tissues. In addition, neferine inhibited LPS and IL-6-induced phosphorylation of both NF-[Formula: see text]B p65 and STAT3. Molecular docking demonstrated the interactions of neferine with both NF-[Formula: see text]B p65 and STAT3. In conclusion, these results suggested that neferine inhibited CA-CRC carcinogenesis possibly by regulating NF-[Formula: see text]B and STAT3. Neferine might be a lead compound for the chemoprevention of CA-CRC.
abstract_zh: 结肠炎是结直肠癌（CRC）发生的重要风险因素。本研究采用氧化偶氮甲烷（AOM）/葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠模型，探讨了莲心碱（neferine）对结肠炎相关结直肠癌（CA-CRC）的抑制作用及其潜在机制。与CA-CRC模型相比，口服莲心碱（2.5和5.0 mg/kg）显著抑制了疾病活动指数（DAI）评分，减少了肿瘤数量，并缩小了肿瘤大小。莲心碱降低了结肠组织中的炎症细胞浸润和上皮增生。莲心碱降低了结肠组织中肿瘤坏死因子-[公式：见原文]（TNF-[公式：见原文]）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1[公式：见原文]）和白细胞介素6（IL-6）的水平。此外，莲心碱显著降低了肿瘤和非肿瘤组织中环氧合酶-2（COX-2）、诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）、p-p65和p-STAT3的蛋白表达。另外，莲心碱抑制了LPS和IL-6诱导的NF-[公式：见原文]B p65和STAT3的磷酸化。分子对接显示了莲心碱与NF-[公式：见原文]B p65和STAT3的相互作用。总之，这些结果表明莲心碱可能通过调节NF-[公式：见原文]B和STAT3来抑制CA-CRC的致癌作用。莲心碱可能成为化学预防CA-CRC的先导化合物。
